jamie_csm: Weekly check-in for Silverleaf onboarding — sharing p95/p99 latency by route/model and streaming vs non-streaming. Quick summary: streaming p95 ~220ms vs non-streaming p95 ~410ms; p99 gaps are largest on api/complete for redwood-1.3-quant.

elena_cs: Thanks — can you drop the numbers here so I can paste into the customer note?

jamie_csm: Sure, pasted quick table below (values are this week's 24h window):
```
route,model,mode,p95_ms,p99_ms,error_rate
api/chat,redwood-1.3,streaming,210,420,0.2%
api/chat,redwood-1.3,non-streaming,395,780,0.5%
api/complete,redwood-1.3-quant,streaming,240,1100,0.9%
api/complete,redwood-1.3-quant,non-streaming,460,1800,1.6%
api/embeds,embed-lite,non-streaming,130,240,0.1%
```
Notes: quant variant shows large p99 tail on api/complete in non-streaming; streaming still reduces p95 but p99 for quant remains high. Error rate bump on complete aligns with spikes.

devin_eng: I dug into sampling traces — several KV cache misses and increased decoder stalls for the quant path. Looks like some longer sequences from their nightly ingest are flushing caches.

mike_sre: Noted a couple of p99 spikes ~14:12/14:34 UTC that correlate with their daily batch. I'll correlate with infra metrics (GPU queue length, batch sizes).

jamie_csm: Uploaded a trace bundle to the thread: trace-silverleaf-2645987112.zip — includes a few example request IDs for the quant p99 cases.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: deployment "redwood-serving/1.3-quant-fix" succeeded for cluster-us-west at 2026-03-14T14:50:07Z :rocket:

jamie_csm: Customer spend: +9% week-over-week. Root cause: higher retry counts (retries visible on api/complete) and more non-streaming tokens billed because clients are falling back. Renewal risk: currently low but watch if cost keeps rising — mark as "monitor". Recommend a short enablement focused on streaming integration and retry/backoff best-practices.

elena_cs: I'll set a 30m enablement with Silverleaf CSM + engineering on Wed 16:00 UTC — sending invite now. Also adding a line to the renewal tracker: "monitor spend + p99 on complete".

jamie_csm: Action items: 1) devin to capture caching policy and propose KV tuning for quant path. 2) mike to add an alert for p99(api/complete) > 1s and add a canary job that mimics their nightly batch. 3) CS to run cost-savings quick wins (batching, prefix caching, streaming enablement) — elena.

devin_eng: Will surface caching policy and a short PR with suggested changes by EOD tomorrow. Also will add sampling to better capture long-sequence requests.

mike_sre: Adding alert and scheduling canary — ETA tomorrow morning. Will post results here.

jamie_csm: Perfect. If we can get quant p99 < 800ms and drop retries by 50% we'll call this week a win. Thanks all :thumbsup:

elena_cs: On it. I'll include recommended playbook in the enablement slides and share post-session notes with Silverleaf.

jamie_csm: Closing loop — will post follow-up metrics after canary + config changes.
